title: Mother and Toddler Wading in Water, 1956 Summer Beach B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black-and-white snapshot stamped 'JUL 56' along the top scalloped border. A young mother wearing a strapless two-piece bathing suit gently leads her toddler daughter through the gentle surf. In the background, palm trees, sunbathers, and beachfront structures create a warm summer vacation atmosphere characteristic of 1950s coastal America.
